Who Can Apply: All landholding farmer families in India
Land Requirement: Must own cultivable land in their name
Income / Other Conditions: Not a govt employee. Not an income tax payer. Not a pensioner above Rs 10000 per month
Key Benefit: Rs 6000 per year paid in 3 instalments of Rs 2000 each directly to bank account

Who Can Apply: Small and marginal farmers aged 18 to 40 years
Land Requirement: Landholding up to 2 hectares
Income / Other Conditions: Not a beneficiary of NPS or ESIC or EPFO. Not an income tax payer
Key Benefit: Rs 3000 per month pension after age 60. Farmer contributes Rs 55 to Rs 200 per month based on age of entry

Who Can Apply: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas
Land Requirement: Must have sown notified crop in notified area
Income / Other Conditions: Loanee farmers enrolled automatically. Non-loanee must apply voluntarily
Key Benefit: Crop insurance cover for loss due to natural calamity pest or disease. Premium only 2% for Kharif 1.5% for Rabi 5% for horticulture. Govt pays remaining premium

Scheme Name: Restructured Weather Based Crop Insurance Scheme (RWBCIS)
Who Can Apply: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas of participating states
Land Requirement: Must grow notified crop
Income / Other Conditions: Available in states that opt for it. Triggered by weather data not crop cutting
Key Benefit: Insurance payout triggered by weather data like rainfall temperature frost. Same low premium as PMFBY

Who Can Apply: All farmers including fishers and animal husbandry farmers
Land Requirement: No minimum land requirement for fishers and livestock farmers
Income / Other Conditions: Should be engaged in cultivation or allied activities
Key Benefit: Short-term crop loan up to Rs 3 lakh at 4% effective interest rate per year after interest subvention

Who Can Apply: Farmers with crop loans up to Rs 3 lakh
Land Requirement: No specific land condition
Income / Other Conditions: Must repay on time to get additional 3% subvention making it 4% effective rate
Key Benefit: Crop loans at 7% with 3% subvention making effective rate 4%. Additional 3% for prompt repayment making it 4% effective

Who Can Apply: All farmers across India who wish to adopt micro-irrigation
Land Requirement: No minimum land size
Income / Other Conditions: Applicable to all farm categories especially small and marginal
Key Benefit: Subsidy on drip and sprinkler irrigation systems. 55% subsidy for general farmers. Additional top-up available via NABARD fund

Who Can Apply: All farmers adopting drip or sprinkler systems
Land Requirement: Any landholding size
Income / Other Conditions: Farmers in notified areas get higher subsidy. SC ST and women farmers get additional subsidy
Key Benefit: 50 to 90% subsidy on micro-irrigation equipment. Promotes water-use efficiency in farming

Who Can Apply: Small and marginal farmers. SC ST farmers. Women farmers. Cooperatives and FPOs
Land Requirement: Priority to small and marginal farmers with less than 2 hectares
Income / Other Conditions: Financial ceiling per beneficiary varies by state and machine type
Key Benefit: 40 to 80% subsidy on purchase of tractors power tillers threshers harvesters and other farm equipment

Who Can Apply: All farmers across India without exception
Land Requirement: No land condition
Income / Other Conditions: Any farmer can get soil tested regardless of farm size or category
Key Benefit: Free soil testing and health card issued every 2 years. Card shows nutrient status and crop-wise fertilizer recommendation

Who Can Apply: Any farmer registered in an e-NAM linked APMC mandi
Land Requirement: No land condition
Income / Other Conditions: Farmer must register at local APMC mandi linked to e-NAM. Over 1200 mandis connected across 18 states
Key Benefit: Online trading of agri produce. Better price discovery. Multiple buyers bid. Funds transferred directly to bank account. Free registration

Who Can Apply: Farmer clusters of minimum 50 farmers covering minimum 50 acres
Land Requirement: Group of farmers must collectively have 50 acres
Income / Other Conditions: Must form cluster and get PGS organic certification over 3 years
Key Benefit: Rs 50000 per hectare financial assistance over 3 years for organic inputs seed procurement packaging and marketing

Who Can Apply: Farmers through state agriculture departments and project mode
Land Requirement: Varies by state and project
Income / Other Conditions: State governments design projects. Farmers benefit through subsidies training and infrastructure
Key Benefit: Additional central funds to states for agriculture infrastructure. Flexible use for new schemes and pilot projects

Who Can Apply: Farmers growing rice wheat pulses coarse cereals and nutri-cereals
Land Requirement: Any land size but focus on low productivity districts
Income / Other Conditions: Applicable in identified low-productivity districts across 28 states
Key Benefit: Subsidised inputs like seeds fertilizers micronutrients farm machinery and training to boost production of food crops

Who Can Apply: Farmers FPOs cooperatives PACS SHGs entrepreneurs agri-startups
Land Requirement: No specific land requirement for individuals
Income / Other Conditions: Loan up to Rs 2 crore per project. Multiple projects allowed subject to cap
Key Benefit: 3% interest subvention on loans for building warehouses cold storage sorting grading units and primary processing facilities

Scheme Name: PM KUSUM Yojana (Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthan Mahabhiyan)
Who Can Apply: All farmers in India especially those with diesel pumps or no electricity connection
Land Requirement: Any land size with irrigation need
Income / Other Conditions: Priority to farmers in regions with poor grid supply
Key Benefit: 60% central subsidy on solar pumps. In some states total subsidy reaches 90%. Reduces irrigation cost significantly

Who Can Apply: Fishermen fish farmers fish vendors SHGs FPOs cooperatives
Land Requirement: No specific land requirement. Need fishery infrastructure like pond or cage
Income / Other Conditions: SC ST women and differently-abled get higher subsidy of 60%. General category gets 40%
Key Benefit: 40 to 60% subsidy for fish ponds hatcheries aquaculture units boats fishing equipment cold chain

Who Can Apply: Farmers engaged in poultry sheep goat pig or fodder cultivation. Entrepreneurs and FPOs
Land Requirement: No land requirement for animal husbandry
Income / Other Conditions: SC ST and women get higher subsidy. Must not be a defaulter with any bank
Key Benefit: 50% capital subsidy for setting up poultry units goat rearing pig farms and fodder blocks. NABARD credit linked

Who Can Apply: Farmers with indigenous cattle and buffalo. Dairy cooperatives
Land Requirement: No minimum holding
Income / Other Conditions: State implementing agencies select beneficiaries
Key Benefit: Conservation and development of indigenous breeds. Free artificial insemination through Gokul Grams. Bull mother farms supported

Who Can Apply: Farmers beekeepers SHGs cooperatives women groups
Land Requirement: No land requirement
Income / Other Conditions: Beginner beekeepers also eligible. Must attend training
Key Benefit: Up to 90% subsidy on bee boxes bee colonies and honey extraction equipment. Promotes pollination and additional income

Who Can Apply: Farmers livestock owners dairy farmers rural households producing organic waste
Land Requirement: Must have cattle or livestock producing dung and organic waste
Income / Other Conditions: Village clusters selected by state governments. Individual and group applications
Key Benefit: Financial support up to Rs 50 lakh for biogas plants. Converts dung to clean fuel and organic manure. Extra income source

Who Can Apply: Women Self-Help Groups (SHGs) selected by state rural livelihood missions
Land Requirement: No land requirement for SHG applying
Income / Other Conditions: SHG must be active and operational for at least one year. Selected by SRLM
Key Benefit: 80% subsidy up to Rs 8 lakh for purchasing agricultural drone. SHG members trained as drone pilots and earn income by renting drones to farmers

Who Can Apply: Registered APEDA member exporters of agricultural and processed food products
Land Requirement: No land condition. Registration with APEDA mandatory
Income / Other Conditions: Must be a valid registered exporter under APEDA
Key Benefit: Financial assistance for packaging branding market development and product certification for export of agri products

Who Can Apply: Farmers entrepreneurs and food processing units
Land Requirement: No specific land requirement
Income / Other Conditions: Must set up or expand food processing facility
Key Benefit: Infrastructure development for food processing. Cold chain creation. Mega food parks. Primary processing centres near farms

Scheme Name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Enterprises (PM FME)
Who Can Apply: Micro food processing units run by individual farmers SHGs cooperatives FPOs
Land Requirement: One district one product focus. Must operate in identified product category of district
Income / Other Conditions: Annual turnover up to Rs 250 crore at enterprise level
Key Benefit: 35% credit-linked subsidy up to Rs 10 lakh for upgrading micro food processing units. Capacity building and branding support

Who Can Apply: Farmers in states that apply to NABARD for micro-irrigation fund
Land Requirement: No direct individual eligibility. States access fund and give additional subsidy to farmers
Income / Other Conditions: States must apply. Farmers benefit through higher subsidy than PMKSY baseline
Key Benefit: Extra subsidy top-up over and above PMKSY subsidy for drip and sprinkler systems in states accessing Rs 5000 crore NABARD fund

Scheme Name: National Mission on Edible Oils Oil Palm (NMEO-OP)
Who Can Apply: Farmers in 15 identified states suitable for oil palm cultivation
Land Requirement: Any size of agricultural land
Income / Other Conditions: Must grow oil palm in identified districts of Andhra Pradesh Telangana Karnataka Tamil Nadu and northeastern states
Key Benefit: Planting subsidy up to Rs 29000 per hectare. Maintenance assistance. Price assurance mechanism for fresh fruit bunches

Who Can Apply: Farmers growing fruits vegetables flowers spices plantation crops
Land Requirement: No minimum area but area-based assistance given
Income / Other Conditions: State horticulture departments implement and select beneficiaries
Key Benefit: Subsidy on planting material drip systems protected cultivation post-harvest management and market infrastructure for horticulture

Scheme Name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
Who Can Apply: Farmers in horticulture sector including individual growers and FPOs
Land Requirement: Any landholding size
Income / Other Conditions: Implemented through state departments. Individual and group applications
Key Benefit: Covers area expansion of fruits vegetables mushrooms spices flowers and plantation crops with subsidies on inputs and infrastructure

Who Can Apply: Farmers wishing to plant bamboo on private or non-forest land
Land Requirement: Private agricultural land required
Income / Other Conditions: Applicable in 23 states. Must plant in non-forest land
Key Benefit: Area expansion of bamboo for income generation and value addition. Subsidy on planting material and post-harvest units

Who Can Apply: Farmers FPOs processors and exporters dealing in tomato onion and potato (TOP crops)
Land Requirement: No direct land condition for processors. Farmers benefit through price stabilization
Income / Other Conditions: Activated when prices fall or rise sharply. Transports surplus to deficit regions
Key Benefit: Price stabilization for tomato onion potato. Transportation and storage subsidy of 50% to move surplus produce. Expanded to all fruits and vegetables

Who Can Apply: Farmers cooperative societies SHGs and agri entrepreneurs
Land Requirement: No specific land requirement. Must have space to build warehouse
Income / Other Conditions: Must get NHB warehouseman license for scientific storage. Warehouse must be in rural area
Key Benefit: Capital subsidy of 25% for SC ST cooperatives and NE region farmers and 15% for others for building scientific rural godowns/warehouses

Who Can Apply: Farmers growing perishable crops like fruits and vegetables
Land Requirement: No specific land size
Income / Other Conditions: Activated when market price falls below cost of production. State must request GoI activation
Key Benefit: Government procures perishable produce at intervention price to prevent distress sale. Price floor protection for non-MSP crops

Who Can Apply: All farmers growing any of the 23 notified crops
Land Requirement: Any farm size for notified crops
Income / Other Conditions: Crops must be of fair average quality. Procurement through FCI and NAFED
Key Benefit: Government announces MSP for 23 crops before sowing season. Procurement at MSP through official agencies if prices fall below MSP

Who Can Apply: All farmers across India for multiple crop-specific sub-schemes
Land Requirement: Varies by sub-scheme. Most have no minimum land requirement
Income / Other Conditions: Umbrella scheme covering rice wheat pulses oilseeds cotton and other crops
Key Benefit: Combines multiple crop production programmes for food security. Subsidised seeds fertilizer micronutrients and technical assistance

Who Can Apply: Farmers in rainfed and drought-prone regions
Land Requirement: Priority to rainfed farmers in water-stressed districts
Income / Other Conditions: Focuses on integrated farming and resource conservation. State-implemented
Key Benefit: Climate adaptation for agriculture. Soil health improvement. Water harvesting. Integrated farming system support in rainfed areas

Who Can Apply: Farmers and rural households keeping cattle buffalo goat sheep or poultry
Land Requirement: No land requirement. Only livestock ownership required
Income / Other Conditions: Must own animals and be engaged in animal husbandry activities
Key Benefit: Loan for buffalo Rs 60249. Loan for cow Rs 40783. Loan for pig Rs 16337. Loan for sheep or goat Rs 4063. Loan for poultry Rs 720 per bird. Effective interest 4%

Who Can Apply: All farmers who want training technology and market information
Land Requirement: No land condition
Income / Other Conditions: Farmers must be in ATMA-covered blocks. All blocks in all states covered
Key Benefit: Free extension services. Farmer field schools. Technology demonstrations. Farmer study tours. Training on new varieties and methods

Scheme Name: Sub-Mission on Seed and Planting Material (SMSP)
Who Can Apply: Farmers who grow certified seed. Seed producers and seed villages
Land Requirement: Seed production area defined
Income / Other Conditions: Must follow seed production standards and get seeds certified by State Seed Certification Agency
Key Benefit: Subsidy on foundation and certified seed production. Infrastructure for seed processing and storage. Capacity building of seed villages

Scheme Name: National Mission on Agricultural Extension and Technology (NMAET)
Who Can Apply: All farmers especially those in remote areas without access to modern technology
Land Requirement: No land condition
Income / Other Conditions: Delivered through KVKs and state agriculture departments across all districts
Key Benefit: Technology demonstration on farmer fields. Mobile apps. Kisan call centres. ICT tools for farm advisory. Linkage to markets

Who Can Apply: Farmers in states that have not adopted PMFBY. Loanee farmers primarily
Land Requirement: Applicable in non-PMFBY states
Income / Other Conditions: Older scheme. Being phased out as PMFBY expands
Key Benefit: Comprehensive crop loss coverage for loanee farmers. Premium partly subsidized by government

Who Can Apply: All KCC holders and farmers seeking crop loans
Land Requirement: No new land requirement
Income / Other Conditions: Linked to Jan Samarth portal. Aadhaar and land record mandatory
Key Benefit: Single portal for interest subvention on crop loans. Tracks loan disbursement and interest relief. Digital integration across banks

Who Can Apply: All farmers who register in national farmer database (Farmer Registry)
Land Requirement: Any farm size
Income / Other Conditions: Aadhaar-linked digital farmer ID required through Farmer Registry portal
Key Benefit: Digital farmer identity. Agri Stack creation. Soil profile mapping. AI-based advisory. Crop planning using satellite data

Who Can Apply: Groups of minimum 10 farmers who form and register an FPO
Land Requirement: Minimum 10 farmers collectively forming an FPO. In hilly areas minimum 5 farmers
Income / Other Conditions: FPO must be registered as company under Companies Act or cooperative
Key Benefit: Rs 15 lakh equity grant per FPO. Rs 18 lakh professional management support over 5 years. Rs 2000 crore credit guarantee fund

Scheme Name: Agri Clinic and Agri Business Centres (ACABC)
Who Can Apply: Agriculture and allied science graduates and diploma holders
Land Requirement: No farm land requirement. Academic qualification mandatory
Income / Other Conditions: Must have degree or diploma in agriculture horticulture animal husbandry fisheries veterinary or forestry
Key Benefit: Training and credit facilitation for setting up agri clinics. Subsidy on bank loans: 36% for individuals and 44% for women and SC ST in NE and hilly states

Scheme Name: National Horticulture Board (NHB) Capital Investment Subsidy
Who Can Apply: Individual farmers cooperatives companies setting up cold storage pack-house and pre-cooling units
Land Requirement: No minimum land. Commercial scale infrastructure expected
Income / Other Conditions: Project cost must meet minimum threshold. Commercial viability assessment required
Key Benefit: 35% credit-linked subsidy for cold storage pre-cooling packhouse and CA storage projects for fruits and vegetables

Who Can Apply: Selected farmers in identified seed villages who produce quality seeds
Land Requirement: Farmer must have adequate land to produce seed crop
Income / Other Conditions: Farmer selected by state agriculture department for seed production in seed village cluster
Key Benefit: Supply of foundation seed at subsidised rate. Training on seed production. Buy-back arrangement for certified seeds produced

Scheme Name: Niti Aayog Aspirational Districts Agriculture Scheme
Who Can Apply: Farmers living in 112 identified aspirational districts across India
Land Requirement: Must live and farm in identified aspirational district
Income / Other Conditions: Only for residents of aspirational districts lagging in development indicators
Key Benefit: Convergence of all central schemes with additional focus and monitoring. Faster benefit delivery. Extra funding for agricultural development

Who Can Apply: Farmers and exporters in 12 identified horticulture clusters
Land Requirement: Must be located in or supply to identified horticulture cluster zones
Income / Other Conditions: Ministry of Commerce implements. Farmers supply to export-oriented value chains
Key Benefit: Pre- and post-harvest support for export-oriented horticulture. Cluster development management units. Market linkage to global buyers

Who Can Apply: Farmers in select pilot states who have crops and assets to insure
Land Requirement: Must own insured assets
Income / Other Conditions: Pilot states only. Bundles multiple insurance products
Key Benefit: Combined insurance package covering crop life accident tractor student scholarship and household assets under one scheme and one premium

Who Can Apply: All PMFBY and RWBCIS beneficiary farmers
Land Requirement: Insured crop must be in notified area
Income / Other Conditions: Digital integration with bank records
Key Benefit: Centralized portal for crop insurance enrolment claim status tracking and grievance redressal. Online claim lodging

Who Can Apply: Rural farmer households with MGNREGA job cards
Land Requirement: No minimum land. Must have job card
Income / Other Conditions: Farmer must demand work through Gram Panchayat. Work must be on own land for individual assets
Key Benefit: 100 days wage employment guaranteed. Farm assets created include bunds farm ponds land levelling wells trenches for on-farm use

Who Can Apply: Farmers in degraded and rainfed watershed areas treated under scheme
Land Requirement: Land within notified watershed treatment area
Income / Other Conditions: Implemented in identified degraded watersheds across the country
Key Benefit: Soil and water conservation through bunding check dams and trenching. Increased moisture in soil. Better yields in rainfed areas

Who Can Apply: Farmers who want to plant trees on farm bunds and boundaries
Land Requirement: Agricultural land required. Trees planted on boundaries or intercrops
Income / Other Conditions: Trees must be compatible with crops grown below them
Key Benefit: Financial assistance for planting trees on farmland. Increases farm income through timber and non-timber forest produce along with crops

Who Can Apply: Farmers in rainfed districts with integrated farming systems
Land Requirement: Located in identified rainfed districts
Income / Other Conditions: Implemented in 25 states. Cluster approach with groups of farmers
Key Benefit: Integrated farming system approach: crop plus horticulture plus livestock plus fishery. Reduces risk from rainfall variability

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay Sanrakshan Abhiyan (PM-AASHA)
Who Can Apply: Farmers growing oilseeds pulses and copra facing market price below MSP
Land Requirement: Farmer must be growing notified crop in participating state
Income / Other Conditions: Procurement or price deficiency payment when market price falls below MSP
Key Benefit: Three components: procurement at MSP through agencies price deficiency payment to farmer bank account or private procurement and stockist scheme

Who Can Apply: Farmers wishing to sell produce online beyond local mandi
Land Requirement: No specific land condition. Produce must meet quality specifications
Income / Other Conditions: Must register and list produce on platform
Key Benefit: Online agri commerce platform enabling farmers to sell directly to buyers. Reduces middlemen and increases farmer price realization

Scheme Name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana Bharat Organic
Who Can Apply: Farmer clusters applying for organic certification under PKVY
Land Requirement: Cluster of minimum 50 farmers covering 50 acres
Income / Other Conditions: Farmers must commit to 3-year conversion period. No synthetic inputs allowed during conversion
Key Benefit: Organic certification support under PGS India system. Rs 50000 per hectare over 3 years for organic inputs and certification

Who Can Apply: Farmers interested in organic farming and compost production
Land Requirement: No minimum area
Income / Other Conditions: Training and awareness creation across all states
Key Benefit: Technical capacity building for organic input production. Vermicompost production support. Biofertilizer distribution

Scheme Name: Mission Organic Value Chain Development for North East India (MOVCDNER)
Who Can Apply: Farmers in 8 northeastern states growing organic produce
Land Requirement: Located in northeastern states: Assam Sikkim Meghalaya Manipur Mizoram Nagaland Tripura Arunachal Pradesh
Income / Other Conditions: Must form farmer groups and adopt organic practices
Key Benefit: Rs 32500 per hectare assistance over 3 years. FPO formation support. Processing and marketing infrastructure for organic NE produce

Who Can Apply: Individual beekeepers farmers SHGs and cooperatives across India
Land Requirement: No land requirement. Must have space for beehives
Income / Other Conditions: Beginner and experienced beekeepers both eligible. Training mandatory before subsidy
Key Benefit: Subsidised supply of bee colonies and hive boxes. Training on honey extraction and certification. Market linkage through NAFED and cooperatives

Who Can Apply: Farmers in states accessing NABARD micro-irrigation fund
Land Requirement: Same as PMKSY beneficiaries in those states
Income / Other Conditions: States approach NABARD for fund. Farmers get extra subsidy top-up on their drip/sprinkler systems
Key Benefit: Additional financial support beyond PMKSY baseline to bridge gap in farmer contribution. Makes micro-irrigation effectively free for small farmers in some states

Who Can Apply: Farmers interested in cultivating medicinal and aromatic plants
Land Requirement: Agricultural land suitable for medicinal plants
Income / Other Conditions: Must grow notified medicinal plants recommended for region
Key Benefit: Financial assistance for cultivation of medicinal plants under-utilized varieties. Linkage to pharmaceutical and herbal industry buyers

Who Can Apply: Coconut farmers in major coconut growing states
Land Requirement: Must own coconut palms aged 4 to 60 years
Income / Other Conditions: State-specific: Kerala Tamil Nadu Karnataka Andhra Pradesh and others
Key Benefit: Insurance coverage for death or damage of coconut palms due to natural calamities or disease. Premium shared between farmer and government

Who Can Apply: Coconut farmers in all coconut growing states
Land Requirement: Must own coconut palms or land suitable for cultivation
Income / Other Conditions: Implemented through state coconut development departments
Key Benefit: Subsidy on planting of improved varieties. Drip irrigation support. Intercropping assistance. Coconut processing unit support

Who Can Apply: Coffee growers in Karnataka Kerala Tamil Nadu Andhra Pradesh and NE states
Land Requirement: Must own land under coffee cultivation
Income / Other Conditions: Registered with Coffee Board of India
Key Benefit: Replanting subsidy. Quality improvement through new processing equipment. Export promotion. Price stabilization through price pooling

Who Can Apply: Rubber growers in Kerala Karnataka Tamil Nadu and NE states
Land Requirement: Must own rubber plantation land
Income / Other Conditions: Registered with Rubber Board. Replanting and new planting eligible
Key Benefit: Replanting subsidy for old rubber trees. New planting financial assistance. Rubber cultivation in NE states with higher subsidy

Who Can Apply: Tea growers in Assam West Bengal Tamil Nadu Kerala Himachal Pradesh
Land Requirement: Must have registered tea estate or small tea garden
Income / Other Conditions: Registered with Tea Board of India
Key Benefit: Replanting and rejuvenation of old tea bushes. Infrastructure for tea processing. Quality certification support

Who Can Apply: Spice growers across India especially in Kerala Karnataka Andhra Pradesh
Land Requirement: Must grow notified spices like pepper cardamom turmeric ginger clove
Income / Other Conditions: Registered with Spices Board for export support
Key Benefit: Crop development support. Organic spice certification. Quality testing facilities. Export market development assistance

Who Can Apply: Cashew farmers in Goa Maharashtra Kerala Karnataka Andhra Pradesh and Odisha
Land Requirement: Must own cashew orchard land
Income / Other Conditions: State agriculture departments implement
Key Benefit: Replanting of old orchards with high-yielding varieties. Processing infrastructure support. Promotion of cashew apple value addition

Who Can Apply: Farmers in 15 states identified for oil palm including Andhra Pradesh Telangana Odisha and NE states
Land Requirement: Agricultural land in identified districts
Income / Other Conditions: Must commit to oil palm cultivation. Assured purchase of Fresh Fruit Bunches by mills
Key Benefit: Planting subsidy up to Rs 29000 per hectare plus annual maintenance subsidy for 4 years. Price assurance above market for FFBs

Scheme Name: National Watershed Development Project for Rainfed Areas (NWDPRA)
Who Can Apply: Farmers in rainfed watershed areas in 25 states
Land Requirement: Land must fall within notified watershed treatment area
Income / Other Conditions: Implemented in village clusters. Community participation mandatory
Key Benefit: Soil and moisture conservation structures. Farm bunds. Drainage line treatment. Community land development. Livelihood support

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana Accelerated Irrigation Benefits Programme (AIBP)
Who Can Apply: Farmers in command areas of ongoing and new irrigation projects
Land Requirement: Land must fall in command area of project
Income / Other Conditions: State governments identify command areas. Farmers benefit from completed irrigation infrastructure
Key Benefit: Completion of long-pending irrigation projects. Field channel development. Water user association formation for equitable water distribution

Who Can Apply: All farmers mandatorily covered for data collection
Land Requirement: All operational holdings surveyed
Income / Other Conditions: No application needed. Government surveys all farmers
Key Benefit: Regular agriculture census to identify farmer numbers land use pattern. Data used for policy and scheme targeting of subsidies to correct beneficiaries

Who Can Apply: Farmers in rice wheat dominant areas wanting to diversify
Land Requirement: Located in identified rice wheat surplus states like Punjab Haryana UP
Income / Other Conditions: Must shift from paddy to alternate crops like maize oilseeds pulses vegetables
Key Benefit: Financial incentive for shifting from water-intensive paddy. Subsidy on seeds inputs and market support for alternate crops grown

Scheme Name: National Food Security Mission Coarse Cereals
Who Can Apply: Farmers growing jowar bajra ragi maize barley in identified districts
Land Requirement: Must cultivate in identified low productivity districts
Income / Other Conditions: State agriculture departments identify beneficiaries in notified blocks
Key Benefit: Subsidised quality seeds of improved varieties. Demonstrations. Nutrient management. Farm implements. Training for productivity enhancement of coarse cereals

Scheme Name: National Food Security Mission Oilseeds and Oil Palm
Who Can Apply: Farmers growing groundnut mustard soybean sunflower sesame in identified districts
Land Requirement: Must farm in identified low productivity districts
Income / Other Conditions: Implemented in 30 states in identified blocks with low oilseed productivity
Key Benefit: Subsidised certified seeds. Demonstrations of improved varieties. Soil amelioration. Integrated pest management. Farm implements for oilseed farmers

Scheme Name: National Food Security Mission Commercial Crops Cotton and Jute
Who Can Apply: Farmers growing cotton and jute in identified states
Land Requirement: Must cultivate in identified cotton and jute growing districts
Income / Other Conditions: Implemented in 9 states for cotton and 7 states for jute
Key Benefit: Hybrid cotton seed distribution. Jute variety replacement. Farm equipment. Integrated pest management. Demonstration plots for productivity

Who Can Apply: Farmers farmer groups cooperatives state agencies creating rural market infrastructure
Land Requirement: No individual land requirement. Infrastructure creation expected
Income / Other Conditions: State governments and agencies apply for funding. Farmers benefit from improved market access
Key Benefit: Grants for rural primary markets rural godowns grading units and market intelligence dissemination. Price discovery support

Who Can Apply: Farmers and consumers affected by sharp price volatility in essential commodities
Land Requirement: No direct application by farmer. Government activates on price triggers
Income / Other Conditions: Government intervenes when prices of pulses onion potatoes edible oils deviate sharply
Key Benefit: Buffer stock creation. Import when prices rise. Sell from buffer when prices rise. Prevents distress selling and consumer price shock

Scheme Name: Central Sector Scheme of Financing Facilities under Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF extended)
Who Can Apply: Farmers FPOs PACS dairy cooperatives fishery cooperatives and agri entrepreneurs
Land Requirement: No specific land requirement. Project must be agriculture-related
Income / Other Conditions: Loan from bank or NBFC. Interest subvention and credit guarantee provided by government
Key Benefit: 3% interest subvention on loans from Rs 2 crore. Upto Rs 2 crore with credit guarantee of 25%. Multiple projects per beneficiary allowed

Who Can Apply: Small and marginal farmers forming or joining an FPO
Land Requirement: Minimum 100 member farmers in plains. Minimum 50 in NE and hilly areas
Income / Other Conditions: Must register FPO as producer company or cooperative
Key Benefit: Rs 15 lakh equity grant per FPO over 3 years. Rs 18 lakh for professional Cluster Based Business Organisation support. Credit guarantee

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay Sanrakshan Abhiyan Price Deficiency Payment (PDPS)
Who Can Apply: Farmers growing oilseeds pulses and copra when market price falls below MSP
Land Requirement: Must sell through registered trader in state government notified market
Income / Other Conditions: State must have registered the farmer before procurement season
Key Benefit: Difference between MSP and actual market price paid directly to farmer bank account. No physical procurement needed from farmer

Scheme Name: Livestock Health and Disease Control Programme (LH&DCP)
Who Can Apply: All livestock and poultry farmers across India
Land Requirement: No land or herd size requirement
Income / Other Conditions: Implemented through state animal husbandry departments
Key Benefit: Free vaccination against FMD PPR brucellosis and classical swine fever. Disease surveillance. Compensation for culled animals in outbreak

Who Can Apply: Cattle buffalo sheep goat and pig farmers across India
Land Requirement: No herd size minimum
Income / Other Conditions: Universal coverage target. 100% vaccination of cattle and buffalo targeted
Key Benefit: Free vaccination and ear tagging of all cattle and buffalo against Foot and Mouth Disease and Brucellosis. Eliminates disease reduces loss

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Kisan Samridhi Saha-Yojana (PM-MKSSS)
Who Can Apply: Small and micro fisheries enterprises fish farmers and fish vendors
Land Requirement: No specific asset size
Income / Other Conditions: Must formalize their enterprise with digital registration
Key Benefit: One-time incentive for formalization. Working capital and MSME credit access. Insurance for fish workers. Progressive credit guarantee

Scheme Name: Blue Revolution Integrated Development and Management of Fisheries
Who Can Apply: Marine and inland fishermen aquaculture farmers fish processing units
Land Requirement: No minimum holding for marine fishermen
Income / Other Conditions: Implemented through states. Priority to small fishermen and women fish vendors
Key Benefit: Fish farm development. Fishing vessel modernization. Processing and cold chain. Fish market infrastructure. Training for fishermen

Who Can Apply: Farmers artisans entrepreneurs in bamboo growing states
Land Requirement: Must have or be near bamboo cultivation area
Income / Other Conditions: Implemented in 23 states. Includes NE states with priority
Key Benefit: Support for bamboo plantation nursery processing agglomeration centres and handicraft clusters. Rs 3500 per farmer for plantation material

Scheme Name: MFOI Scheme (Meri Fasal Mera Byora Haryana State)
Who Can Apply: All farmers in Haryana state only
Land Requirement: Must own or lease farmland in Haryana
Income / Other Conditions: Haryana state scheme only. Mandatory for subsidy benefits
Key Benefit: State portal for crop registration before sowing. Mandatory for availing input subsidies. Links to PM-KISAN and state schemes

Who Can Apply: All farmers including tenant farmers in Andhra Pradesh
Land Requirement: Must farm in Andhra Pradesh. Tenant farmers also eligible unlike PM-KISAN
Income / Other Conditions: State residents only. Aadhaar and land record linking required
Key Benefit: Rs 13500 per year per farmer family. Covers all categories including tenant farmers. Paid in 2 instalments per year

Who Can Apply: Small and marginal farmers of Jharkhand with up to 5 acres of land
Land Requirement: Must hold up to 5 acres in Jharkhand. Must be state resident
Income / Other Conditions: Jharkhand state scheme only. Land must be registered in farmer name
Key Benefit: Rs 5000 per acre per year assistance. Maximum benefit for 5 acres is Rs 25000 per year. Direct bank transfer to farmer account

Who Can Apply: Farmers in Madhya Pradesh growing registered crops when market price falls below MSP
Land Requirement: Must register crop before sowing on MP state portal
Income / Other Conditions: MP state scheme. Must sell in registered notified mandi. Crops include soybean maize urad moong peanut sesame
Key Benefit: Difference between MSP and average modal price paid directly to farmer bank account when crop price falls below MSP

Scheme Name: KALIA Scheme Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation (Odisha)
Who Can Apply: Small marginal and landless farmers in Odisha. Includes cultivators and landless agricultural labour
Land Requirement: Small marginal landless farmers and vulnerable agri-households in Odisha
Income / Other Conditions: Odisha state scheme only. Verified beneficiary list
Key Benefit: Rs 10000 per year for small and marginal farmers in two instalments. Rs 12500 support for landless labourers for agri activities

Who Can Apply: Farmers in Haryana adopting modern and precision farming techniques
Land Requirement: Must farm in Haryana. No minimum land size
Income / Other Conditions: Haryana state farmers only
Key Benefit: Financial aid and subsidies for drip irrigation greenhouses precision tools and sustainable farming practices. Training and demonstration support

Who Can Apply: Farmers in Chhattisgarh growing paddy sugarcane maize groundnut soybean
Land Requirement: Must farm in Chhattisgarh and grow notified crops
Income / Other Conditions: Chhattisgarh state scheme. Farmer must register crop before cultivation
Key Benefit: Input assistance of Rs 9000 to Rs 10000 per acre per year depending on crop grown. Direct bank transfer. Kharif and rabi crops covered

Who Can Apply: Farmers in Karnataka growing millet crops like ragi jowar bajra
Land Requirement: Must be farming in Karnataka and growing notified millet crops
Income / Other Conditions: Karnataka state scheme. Special focus on millet growing small farmers
Key Benefit: Financial assistance per acre to millet farmers. Supports conservation of traditional crops. Promotes nutritious crop production in Karnataka

Who Can Apply: Farmers in participating states growing fruits vegetables spices or flowers
Land Requirement: Must grow horticultural crops on agricultural land
Income / Other Conditions: Implemented in states like Himachal Pradesh and Bihar. State-specific eligibility
Key Benefit: Subsidy for nursery material greenhouse construction drip systems packaging and post-harvest infrastructure for horticulture independence

Who Can Apply: Farmers and rural entrepreneurs in states like Kerala Maharashtra Odisha setting up poultry units
Land Requirement: No minimum land. Must have infrastructure for poultry shed
Income / Other Conditions: State-specific. Must apply through state animal husbandry department or NABARD scheme
Key Benefit: Subsidy on shed construction equipment and day-old chicks. Credit linkage through NABARD. Training on poultry management

Who Can Apply: Small and marginal farmers in states like Punjab Karnataka Bihar and others
Land Requirement: Priority to small and marginal farmers with less than 2 hectares
Income / Other Conditions: State agriculture departments select beneficiaries. Priority to SC ST women and small farmers
Key Benefit: 25 to 50% subsidy on purchase of new tractors and power tillers for small farmers. Additional subsidy in some states for SC ST categories

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana Har Khet Ko Pani
Who Can Apply: Farmers without any source of irrigation in uncovered areas
Land Requirement: Must own agricultural land with no existing irrigation source
Income / Other Conditions: Priority to areas with no irrigation coverage. Groundwater and surface water both covered
Key Benefit: Creation of new water sources like borewells ponds canals and lift irrigation to bring every field under irrigation coverage
